claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM the compound is expected to be largely inactive, since HMGCR inhibition by statins is cytostatic rather than cytotoxic in 5-day pooled viability screens and no member of the screened class vocabulary shares a statin-like killing pattern.
